meta.topic: Photovoltaic system configuration and coupling with electric loads
key_finding_on_coupling: The PV config has NO key that points to a heat pump or to the building: the PV calculator is decoupled.

The link is made through DATA: the input DataFrame column 'E_site_el_load_kWh' is the electricity demand the PV is self-consumed against. Whatever you sum into that column (heat pump electricity, ventilation fans, lighting, appliances, pump/fan auxiliaries) is what the PV 'covers'.

Hourly link: works for any load you have hourly (building appliances/lighting, W_*_aux_kWh of emission/distribution/storage, E_C_total_kWh of CoolingGenerationSystemCalculator, CHP/boiler timeseries).

Heat pump: HeatPumpSystemCalculator returns temperature BINS (not an hourly series), so there is no native hourly HP-electricity column. Options: (a) annual link (as done in examples/heat_pump_15316_4_2_example.py), (b) distribute summary['E_total_electricity_kWh'] over the hours yourself, e.g. proportionally to the hourly thermal demand (see coupling_recipes).
Downstream: E_grid_after_PV_kWh and E_PV_export_kWh are recognised by PrimaryEnergyAccountingCalculator as delivered and exported electricity.

time_step_hours.description: Fallback when the input has neither a time_step_hours/dt_h column nor a DatetimeIndex.

demand_unit.description: Unit of raw thermal demand columns (only relevant for solar thermal). Electricity columns are always kWh.

annual_yield_kWh_kWp.description: Specific annual yield at the site (e.g. from PVGIS). Expected annual generation = capacity * yield * (1-shading) * (1-orientation) * (1-degradation).

performance_ratio.description: PR, used only to shape the hourly profile when a GHI column is present (the annual total is rescaled to the expected yield).

orientation_loss_fraction.description: Loss due to non-optimal azimuth/tilt (not modelled geometrically: apply it here).

description.fixed_fraction: Self-consumed energy each step = min(E_site_el_load_kWh, generation * self_consumption_fraction).
description.dispatch: Step-by-step dispatch: direct use first, surplus charges the battery (if any), residual load discharges it, remainder is exported/imported. Forced automatically when a battery capacity > 0 is set.

self_consumption_fraction.description: Max share of generation usable on site (1.0 = everything that matches the load).

roundtrip_efficiency.description: Split evenly: charge and discharge efficiency = sqrt(roundtrip).

initial_soc_fraction.description: State of charge at the first step.

config_schema.solar_thermal: Same calculator also accepts a 'solar_thermal' block (area_m2, annual_yield_kWh_m2, priority dhw_first|heating_first|proportional, ...) which reduces Q_H/Q_W upstream of the heat pump. Not part of the PV configuration and omitted here.

timeseries_input.index: DatetimeIndex recommended (step inferred from median spacing).

electric_load.role: The electricity the PV is self-consumed against. THIS is the link to heat pump / building.
electric_load.note: If missing, PV generation is computed but nothing is self-consumed (all exported).

irradiance.role: Optional: shapes the hourly PV profile. The annual total is always rescaled to capacity * annual_yield * losses.
irradiance.fallback: Deterministic daylight/month profile when no irradiance is present.

outputs.balance: E_grid_after_PV_kWh = load - E_PV_self_consumed_kWh ; E_PV_export_kWh = generation - direct use - battery charge (surplus).

hourly_available.building_lighting_and_appliances: your own hourly series (or LightingSystemCalculator timeseries 'E_L_total_kWh')
hourly_available.chp_or_boiler_auxiliaries: CogenerationSystemCalculator / CombustionBoilerSystemCalculator timeseries (they read E_site_el_load_kWh themselves)

A_pv_to_building_electric_loads_hourly: loads['E_site_el_load_kWh'] = lighting_kWh + appliances_kWh + fans_kWh   # hourly, same DatetimeIndex as GHI/PV
B_pv_to_heat_pump_and_building_hourly_ap: loads['E_site_el_load_kWh'] = other_loads_kWh + e_hp_year * thermal / thermal.sum()   # HP electricity distributed proportionally to thermal demand (approximation)
C_annual_link_as_in_repo_example: E_PV_export = pv_gen - self_consumed ; E_grid_after_PV = annual_electricity_load_kWh - self_consumed
(this is renewable_summary_with_electric_load() inside examples/heat_pump_15316_4_2_example.py; it is example code, not library API)

pv_fixed_fraction_simple.description: 4.5 kWp, no battery, 100% of matching generation usable on site.

pv_limited_self_consumption.description: Same array, but only 70% of generation is assumed usable (inverter limits, curtailment).

pv_with_battery_dispatch.description: 4.5 kWp + 5 kWh battery, hourly dispatch (direct use -> charge -> discharge -> export/import).

pv_dispatch_without_battery.description: Step-by-step matching without storage (instantaneous self-consumption only).

pv_hourly_profile_from_ghi.description: Provide a GHI column in the input DataFrame: the hourly shape follows irradiance, the annual total stays at capacity * yield * losses.
